author: henriquevigel
quote: I was expecting so much more; after a 13-year wait, we get a GTA that just has nice graphics but a generic story—it feels like a movie about married criminals. The game is full of bugs—which, in a way, is the essence of GTA, but it completely undermines the goal of realism. Like I said, a 13-year wait that resulted in a whole lot of junk.

author: henriquevigel
quote: An INCREDIBLY WONDERFUL AND EPIC game, even by today’s standards. It features many EXCELLENT elements—most notably the ability to use an Ocarina to play notes during gameplay. The game includes significant improvements to both combat mechanics and environmental movement—such as the ability to run faster—which really helps. My only minor gripe is that it could have been a bit more challenging; it doesn’t need to be as difficult as some other games out there, but a little more challenge would have been nice. In short, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is EPIC.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
